Basic chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with system and user messages

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 16, messages: [{ role: "system", system: { content: "You are a helpful assistant." } } as Message, { role: "user", user: { content: "Say hello in one word." } } as Message], model: "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022", temperature: 0 });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.model);
  console.log(result.usage?.totalTokens);
}

void main();
```
